landingTrustedSourcesBody.source: Every āyah shows its sūrah and number. Every hadith shows its collection, number and grade, and we only include narrations graded ṣaḥīḥ or ḥasan. Where the schools of thought differ, the app tells you. We ask qualified scholars to review religious content before each release.
landingTrustedSourcesBody.text: Setiap ayat memaparkan nama surah dan nombornya. Setiap hadis disertakan nama himpunan, nombor dan tarafnya. Hanya riwayat bertaraf sahih atau hasan disertakan. returnHopeMeaning.source: Do not lose hope in Allah’s mercy. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.
returnHopeMeaning.text: Jangan berputus asa daripada rahmat Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah mengampuni segala dosa.

source.adult: Whatever happened, you’re here now. Tawbah literally means to return, and the door doesn’t close.
source.maktab: Everyone makes mistakes. “Astaghfirullāh” is how we say sorry to Allah, and He loves to forgive.

text.adult: Apa pun yang berlaku, anda di sini sekarang. Taubat bermaksud kembali. Pintu taubat sentiasa terbuka.
text.maktab: Semua orang pernah tersilap. Apabila kita menyebut “Astaghfirullāh”, kita memohon ampun kepada Allah. Allah suka mengampuni.

source.adult: Feeling remorse is part of tawbah. The door is still open.
source.maktab: It’s okay to feel sorry. That means your heart is good.

text.adult: Rasa menyesal adalah sebahagian daripada taubat. Pintu taubat masih terbuka.

source.adult: If someone was wronged, make it right where you can.
source.maktab: If you hurt someone, say sorry to them too.

text.adult: Jika anda menzalimi seseorang, perbaiki keadaan setakat yang anda mampu.

source.adult: Intend not to go back. If you slip, return again.
source.maktab: Try your best not to do it again.
